mapper.sql: LEDGER_ID, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE, PERIOD, OPENING_BALANCE, DEBIT_AMOUNT, CREDIT_AMOUNT, CLOSING_BALANCE, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CREATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, PERIOD as period, SUM(DEBIT_AMOUNT) as totalDebit, SUM(CREDIT_AMOUNT) as totalCredit, MIN(OPENING_BALANCE) as openingBalance, MAX(CLOSING_BALANCE) as closingBalance FROM T_GENERAL_LEDGER WHERE SUBJECT_CODE = #{subjectCode} AND PERIOD = #{period} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, PERIOD

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) as subjectCount, SUM(DEBIT_AMOUNT) as debitTotal, SUM(CREDIT_AMOUNT) as creditTotal, SUM(OPENING_BALANCE) as openingTotal, SUM(CLOSING_BALANCE) as closingTotal FROM T_GENERAL_LEDGER WHERE PERIOD = #{period} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT SUBJECT_CODE as columnCode, SUBJECT_CODE as columnName, SUM(DEBIT_AMOUNT) as amount FROM T_GENERAL_LEDGER WHERE PERIOD LIKE CONCAT(#{periodRange}, '%') AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND SUBJECT_CODE != #{subjectCode} AND IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY SUM(DEBIT_AMOUNT + CREDIT_AMOUNT) DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
